correctness.rationale: Fourier diagonalization, cosine collision factorization, Galois/Ramanujan average and exact order enumeration exclude all extra spectrum coincidences. Counting Fourier modes proves the q(n) eigenspace multiplicity; PBH gives the lower bound and a Vandermonde minor for consecutive vertices gives attainability. General proof applies to all n>=5. Finite verifier independently returned 816 assertions, not mistaken for proof.

value.rationale: Minimum independently actuated vertices is a meaningful exact invariant for four-regular Laplacian consensus networks. The sharp divisibility by 5, 6, 12 and nonmonotone 2/3/4 hierarchy are structural arithmetic boundaries; the explicit consecutive construction applies uniformly to every size.
